svg.text: FIG-R11 · Coverage matrix: 19 RV categories × 22 measurement dimensions (four-state, PN-27)
Source: R8 Reverse Anchor Register v0-2 §5 (cells parsed verbatim; recomputed by r8_coverage.py) and §1 (MD names)
Totals (computed from the parsed cells): measured 77 · derived only 3 · design 115 · empty 223 of 418 cells, matching the R8 v0-2 §5 headline.
Red measured totals = no measured cell: MD-01, MD-02, MD-03, MD-10, MD-16, MD-18, MD-20, MD-21 (R8 §5: one automining node, PF-39, and absent hardware).
v0-1's 128 measured cells fell to 77 through the measured/derived split (PN-27), the slash rule and the PN-23 downgrades; R8 states no measurement was lost.
Cell code (R8 §5): green = ≥ 1 St-M row evidencing the MD (before slash) · blue = Dv only · dashed = MD targeted, not evidenced (Ds, I, E, S, —, or after slash) · white = no row.
Source: R8 Reverse Anchor Register v0-2 §5 cell code (PN-27); I never counts as measured. Scale R9 PN-32 · make_phase2_figures_v0-2.py (v0-2 inputs).
